meta.title: Teeth Whitening | The British Dental Hub
meta.description: A brighter, more confident smile achieved safely and under clinical supervision, with in-office and custom take-home whitening options in Cairo.

hero.title: A Brighter Smile, Safely and Under Clinical Supervision
hero.subtitle: Every whitening treatment is planned around your teeth and gums, so the result feels confident, natural, and safely achieved.

options.title: Whitening Options
options.subtitle: Two considered approaches, so treatment fits how you'd like to experience it.

inOffice.title: In-Office Teeth Whitening
inOffice.description: A professional whitening treatment carried out here in the clinic, under close clinical supervision from start to finish.
inOffice.note: Ideal for: patients who prefer their whitening fully managed in-clinic

takeHome.title: Custom Take-Home Whitening Trays
takeHome.description: Whitening trays made specifically for your teeth, for you to use at home following clear professional guidance and instructions.
takeHome.note: Ideal for: patients who prefer a guided, at-home whitening routine

beforeYouWhiten.title: A safe starting point, checked first.
beforeYouWhiten.description: Every whitening treatment begins with a preliminary clinical assessment to check that your teeth and gums are ready. Issues such as untreated decay or gum concerns are identified and addressed first, so whitening treatment can proceed safely and effectively.

consultationCta.title: Ready for a Brighter Smile?
consultationCta.description: Every whitening treatment begins with a comprehensive consultation. We'll assess your suitability, explain every available option, and shape a plan around your needs.
consultationCta.noPressure: No pressure. Just honest clinical advice.
consultationCta.contactNote: Our team will personally contact you to arrange your consultation at a convenient time.
